description: Public DNS records over Google DoH. Up to four record types, DNS status, TTL and authenticated-data flag. Authorized domains only, no SMTP or mailbox verification. Email-shaped values are redacted. Costs $0.0009 USDC per call via x402. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].

domain.description: Authorized DNS domain, ASCII/punycode, no URL or email

types.description: 1 to 4 distinct DNS record types; default A, AAAA, MX

name: dns_records
title: Johto Data DNS Record Lookup
